About the UX/UI Designer interview
This UX/UI Designer interview evaluates a candidate’s ability to create intuitive interfaces, gather user feedback, and collaborate across teams. This screening tool helps you hire UX/UI design experts who build solutions that drive business success.
Applied AI & workflows
Learning & digital agility
Who it's for
Ideal for: UI Designer, UX Designer.
Strong UX/UI design professionals are critical to creating digital products that delight users and meet business goals. Hiring people who can design with empathy, adapt to user feedback, and work fluidly with cross-functional teams ensures your products are both functional and user-friendly. This UX/UI Designer interview evaluates candidates’ abilities to demonstrate relevant UX/UI experience, design effective user interfaces, gather user feedback into design, use design implementation tools, collaborate across product teams, and address user pain points through design.
These core areas reflect the end-to-end responsibilities of a skilled UX/UI designer. This screening interview will help you identify UX/UI designers who understand the entire design process—from discovery to delivery—and can deliver interfaces that are not only visually appealing but also purpose-driven. Candidates who do well on this interview will likely come equipped to create user-focused products, streamline team collaboration, and enhance the overall user experience.
The test is made by a subject-matter expert
TestGorilla’s tests are created by subject matter experts. We assess potential subject-matter experts based on their knowledge, ability, and reputation.
Before being published, each test is peer-reviewed by another expert, then calibrated using hundreds of test takers with relevant experience in the subject.
Our feedback mechanisms and unique algorithms allow our subject-matter experts to constantly improve their tests.
Talent and Assessment Science CoE
TestGorilla's Talent and Assessment Science CoE delivers leading-edge AI-driven evaluation tools, science-based assessment content, and the deep technical insights required to navigate the future of talent acquisition. The CoE comprises IO psychologists, data scientists, psychometricians, LLM architects, machine learning engineers, and applied researchers. Collectively, they boast more than 15 advanced degrees, and decades of assessment and talent acquisition industry experience.
